rationale: Recurring Czech broker news feed summarising PSE issuer/board announcements; standalone monitorable tripwire for bank leadership events.
Czech banking trade press hub that continuously reports AGM outcomes and board/exec changes; public front page, monitor for A5 signals.
Single gov.cz service-catalogue page among 22 siblings; procedural background only, covered by monitoring the portal/regulator parent.
One-off annual-report PDF useful to enumerate listed issuers, but not a recurring signal stream itself.
ČBA committee/working-group roster maps named payments, cards and digitalisation owners inside member banks; mine once and re-snapshot for diffs.
Canonical directory of ~35 Czech banks covering >99% of the sector; the actor list underpinning all A5 jobs/leadership monitoring.
ČBA press-release feed carries dated presidium/supervisory-committee elections naming sitting bank CEOs; durable standalone feed.
Czech card/payments association member+observer list enumerates acquirers, processors and ATM/terminal players — core payments actor set.
Best directory of Czech non-bank payment institutions and fintechs; mine for the payments watch-list, re-check periodically.
ČLFA governing-bodies page names current leasing/consumer-credit executives and updates on elections; monitorable for dated leadership moves.
~39 non-bank finance companies adjacent to banking/payments; one-off directory harvest for the actor list.
AKAT member directory plus elected leadership gives asset-management arms of banks; useful once, with periodic re-snapshot.
Finance Committee page names senior banking executives and recurring activity; English-language, cheap ongoing people signal.
AmCham board page is a section of a domain already monitored via the committee page; board turnover signal is real but sibling-covered.
Cross-sector corporate member directory; mine once to extend the bank/payments/vendor watch-list, not a continuous signal source.
Single transparency-register datacard useful as an independent cross-check on chamber personnel; not a recurring feed.
Internet/media association board is digital-economy adjacency only; weak link to banking or payments actors.
ICT Unie bodies and members cover IT vendors staffing Czech bank and payments systems; in scope under the do-not-narrow reading, monitor for vendor-side moves.
Directory of MiCA-era Czech crypto/digital-asset firms now hiring compliance and payments staff; harvest once, moderate credibility.
Pointer-of-pointers to financial-sector associations, but URL verification failed; re-check liveness before mining.
Official association register with dated statutory-body entries; authoritative, continuously updated cross-check on association and bank-linked leadership.
LinkedIn org pages are people-rich but login-gated and ToS-restricted for automated collection; a human must clear access and legal basis.
Low-credibility aggregator mirror of association lists and URL verification failed; only a fallback if primaries are unreachable.
ČBA event/speaker pages sit on a domain already monitored via its press feed; speaker rosters add title-level confirmation but no standalone endpoint.
